City of Chicago
                                                                     O2021-2998
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/21/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Misc. Transmittal
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-H at 3840 N Lincoln Ave
                              App No. CPC-5
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B1-2,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in
the area bound by:

      a line 136,1 feet north of West Berenice Avenue and perpendicular to North Lincoln
      Avenue as measured along the northeasterly right-of-way; North Lincoln Avenue; West
      Berenice Avenue; and a line 136.1 feet west of and parallel to North Lincoln Avenue,

to those of a B1-3, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        Maurice D. Cox
                                                        Commissioner, DPD




Common Address:
3840 N. Lincoln Avenue
